title: nothim
description: This mod adds various scary events and serves as an addition to other horror mods.
body:
# NotHim
![nothim](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef10ae50e26a63fc6a71a46f75e848333fff1bff_0.webp)

This mod adds a "Warning" entity that wants to kick you out of Minecraft. It will cause glitches, break textures, and try to scare you into leaving your world. "Warning" enjoys solitude and dislikes being visited.

### WARNING! 
This mod adds: 
- Screamers
- Loud sounds

Besides Minecraft, he can:
- System errors
- Crashing your Minecraft
- Restart your PC
- Open programs
- Close explorer.exe
  
### COMMANDS
- /nothim events <name_event> - allows you to call the event you need
- /nothim status - allows you to see the time until the next event


### Teams of Use
You are free to use the mod in your video or anywhere else. Linking to the mod in the description is optional.

You are not allowed to publish this mod on other third party services or make your own versions of mod.
